theorems.name: Submission.c1_level_slices_countablyRectifiable
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (D : Set (Rn (m + k))) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m), 0 < k → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ D → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn m)), CountablyRectifiable k (ψ '' (D ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
